planets.name: Kepler-90 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-90 with a 8.72-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-90 c was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 8 planets known around Kepler-90. Its orbit and size follow Cabrera et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
